bulkReview.title: Plan review & supervision
bulkReview.loadingNote: Validating factories, inspection checklist, Inspectors and duplicates…
bulkReview.stagedBanner: Staged review. No plan record exists yet — nothing is saved until you submit it for supervision.
bulkReview.stagedSub: Selected factories carried from targeting · verifying sources
bulkReview.unavailable: Planning data is not available right now. Go back to targeting and try again once access is fixed.
bulkReview.emptyBody: Select target factories on the targeting screen, then continue to review.
bulkReview.scopeTitle: Selection is no longer fully in scope
bulkReview.scopeBody: {n} selected factory record(s) could not be read in your current scope. Nothing was silently removed or published; return to targeting and refresh the selection.
bulkReview.scopeReduced: Removed {removed} duplicate factory record(s). {retained} retained — readiness re-checked.
bulkReview.packageHint: No checklist selected — that is allowed. The inspector chooses an eligible checklist during preparation.
bulkReview.droppedH: {n} row(s) were excluded at the authoritative submission re-check
bulkReview.droppedD: These rows became ineligible between the last check and the commit. They were NOT submitted; everything else committed atomically.
bulkReview.notes: Notes (optional, applied to every visit in this plan)
bulkReview.notesPlaceholder: Anything Inspectors or Supervisors should know before these visits…
bulkReview.blockersN: {n} items must be resolved before submission
bulkReview.clearAll: All checks pass — the plan is ready for supervision
bulkReview.autoNote: A Supervisor confirms one named Inspector before release. No automatic assignment is made.
bulkReview.manualNamed: Planner proposal — subject to Supervisor confirmation
bulkReview.manualEvidenceNote: Named Inspectors are proposals only. The Supervisor confirms or replaces them during approval.
bulkReview.ledgerLead: Exactly what submission will and will not do, bound to the current retained scope.
bulkReview.gCreate: Will be created on successful commit
bulkReview.gRef: Will be referenced for those visits
bulkReview.cPlanD: A single plan grouping every retained visit under one plan ID.
bulkReview.cVisitsD: One physical periodic-compliance visit per retained factory.
bulkReview.rTypeD: Visit type and execution mode applied to every visit.
bulkReview.rWinD: The single window every visit in this campaign shares.
bulkReview.rMethodD: Planner selections are proposed Inspectors; the Supervisor owns final assignment.
bulkReview.recAuditD: Plan, visit and assignment inserts are captured by the append-only table triggers with actor and timestamp.
bulkReview.recNotifD: Queued for sending only — created inside the transaction. Delivery, receipt and acceptance are not proven here.
bulkReview.notStartD: Publishing schedules visits; it does not begin any inspection.
bulkReview.notDeliver: No message is delivered or accepted
bulkReview.notDeliverD: Notification rows are queued; provider delivery and Inspector acceptance are separate, unproven events.
bulkReview.notDropD: Excluded factories are named explicitly; excluded scope never disappears.
bulkReview.notPartial: No partial result is called success
bulkReview.notPartialD: All-or-nothing: any guard or write failure rolls the whole transaction back.
bulkReview.notFinal: A committable retained scope is not final yet — resolve the blockers to lock the counts.
bulkReview.backConfigD: Return to targeting with this selection preserved.
bulkReview.willRecheck: On submission the server re-checks role, checklist status, target identity and duplicates in one transaction. Supervisors then confirm each final Inspector before release.
bulkReview.allClear: All checks pass — the server will commit all-or-nothing.
bulkReview.publishReady: Submit plan and create {n} supervision requests
bulkReview.publishingBody: The server is validating and committing the plan and pending supervision requests in one transaction. Do not close this page.
bulkReview.publishingSub: ‘Published’ is not shown until a Supervisor approves and assigns each visit.
bulkReview.failBody: No plan or pending supervision request was created.
bulkReview.failSub: Technical details are logged server-side only.
bulkReview.successBody: The authoritative transaction committed in full.
bulkReview.successSub: Notifications are queued for sending only — no delivery, acceptance or inspection start. Zero completed visits and zero drafts at this moment.
bulkReview.ackRequired: {n} selected row(s) are ineligible. Acknowledge below to proceed with the eligible subset only, or go back and adjust the selection.
bulkReview.ackLabel: Proceed with the {n} eligible factories only — ineligible rows are named above and will not be submitted.
bulkReview.draftSaveFailed: The draft could not be saved. Your working state is unchanged — you can retry or continue without saving.
bulkReview.draftBanner: Resumed from draft {ref} — saved working state; readiness is re-checked live.
bulkReview.draftUnavailable: We couldn't load this draft. It may have been published, archived, or created by someone else. Using your last selection instead.
bulkReview.evLead: Focus a factory row (or choose “Review evidence”) to see target facts and any Planner proposal. Availability is resolved by the Supervisor during approval — no score, rank or confidence is shown.
bulkReview.ecAuto: no preference — Supervisor selects the final Inspector at approval
bulkReview.ecFail: availability could not be read — Supervisor will resolve final allocation at approval
bulkReview.ecSetWindow: set an inspection window to check overlap

ev.noneBody: Nothing for this candidate yet. Focus a factory row or choose “Review evidence” to reflect its facts here. Blocked picks are shown on their own ledger with the exact visit and time.
ev.vRole: Holds the Inspector role (in the eligible pool)
ev.vOverlap0: No overlapping active visit in the window (overlap query ran)
ev.vPkg: Inspection checklist is currently active or locked
ev.neList: Skills · work hours · capacity · territory · proximity · travel time — no Inspection Platform source, not evaluated
ev.neAuto: No preference — the Supervisor selects the final Inspector during approval.
ev.neWindow: Overlap not evaluated — set a valid inspection window first
ev.bOverlap: Already booked on {n} overlapping visit(s) — e.g. {label}, {window}
ev.bNotPool: Not in the eligible Inspector pool
ev.bFail: Availability evidence could not be read. This does not create an assignment; the Supervisor resolves allocation at approval.
ev.bNone: Nothing blocks this candidate right now
ev.checked: Target identity, checklist validity and duplicate visits are re-checked just before the plan is written. Final allocation is an explicit Supervisor decision.

duplicate.title: Active periodic visit already exists — cannot create a duplicate

overlap.title: Proposed Inspector has an overlapping visit

coverage.title: Inspector coverage is decided during supervision
coverage.detail: The Supervisor confirms the final assignment.

capacity.title: Inspector capacity is decided during supervision
capacity.detail: The Supervisor confirms the final assignment.

nopackage.title: No inspection checklist selected
nopackage.detail: Allowed: the inspector chooses an eligible checklist during preparation. Publishing proceeds without one.

packageInvalid.title: Selected inspection checklist is no longer active at the authoritative check
packageInvalid.detail: Revalidate and choose a currently active version before publishing.

nopool.title: No Inspector is currently in the role pool
nopool.detail: Submission remains possible; a Supervisor must assign an eligible Inspector before release.

configMissing.title: Mandatory configuration is missing
configMissing.detail: Set the visit type, a valid window (end after start) and an inspection checklist.

windowImplausible.title: Visit window date looks like a data-entry error
windowImplausible.detail: Check for a mistyped year — the date is outside the plausible range (DEF-DATA-005).

srcFactory.title: Factory/target source could not be verified
srcFactory.detail: Not evaluated — blocks safely rather than showing false emptiness.

srcPackage.title: Inspection checklist data is not available
srcPackage.detail: Distinct from ‘no inspection checklist’ — the state is not evaluated, not empty.

srcInspector.title: Inspector data is not available
srcInspector.detail: Distinct from ‘empty pool’ — an empty pool cannot be confirmed.

srcDuplicate.title: Duplicate check could not run
srcDuplicate.detail: Distinct from ‘verified zero conflicts’ — submission is not allowed without this check.

consequences.assign: Allow a preferred Inspector, but require a Supervisor to confirm or replace them

consequences.reviewConfirm: I reviewed the mandatory information and duplicate-active-visit rule
